CFML Language Reference: Functions

IsStruct

Returns YES if the value is a structure created with StructNew.

Category

Decision functions

Syntax

IsStruct(value)

Parameters

value
Any value.

Returns

YES or NO.

Usage

Check with IsStruct before calling structure functions on values whose type you cannot be sure of, for instance data that arrived in a WDDX packet.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Employee = StructNew()>
<CFSET Employee.Name = "Ada">
<CFSET Employee.Dept = "Engineering">
<CFSET Roster = ArrayNew(1)>
<CFSET Roster[1] = Employee>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Expression</TH><TH>IsStruct</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>Employee</TD><TD>#IsStruct(Employee)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Employee.Name</TD><TD>#IsStruct(Employee.Name)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Roster</TD><TD>#IsStruct(Roster)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Roster[1]</TD><TD>#IsStruct(Roster[1])#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>
